layer1.name: Josephine
layer1.one_liner: A marketplace for home-cooked meals sold by neighbourhood cooks.
layer1.description: Home cooks listed meals, neighbours ordered and collected them. Positioned as income for cooks and better food for buyers, with Josephine taking a percentage.
layer1.outcome_note: Closed after failing to resolve the food-safety regulation that made home kitchens illegal to sell from in most jurisdictions. The demand was demonstrable; the legal route to serving it was not.
